newsitem.title: USA: Sunbeam silent on downsizing report.
newsitem.headline: Sunbeam silent on downsizing report.

text.p: Sunbeam Corp says its chief executive will hold a conference call with Wall Street analysts on Tuesday afternoon but it declined to comment on reports he would announce big lay offs and a restructuring.
The New York Times said Sunbeam, whose products include small appliances, patio furniture and gas grills, was expected to fire as many as one third of its 12,000-person workforce.
Chief executive Albert Dunlap was also expected to announce a consolidation of operations and that unproductive lines would be sold or discontinued, the Times said.
"We cannot not make any comment," Laurie Becker of the Investors Relations department said. "You can dial in to the conference call this afternoon."
